title: Cross, confession, and the martyr’s contest (chs. 3–25)
english: Remember the contest; [[deny yourself and take up the cross >> Bible:Matthew 16:24]]. Flee idolatry and confess the one God. Keep the tongue clean, for evil speech is abomination before the Lord.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2 Exhortatio (OCR); no O’Meara/Greer wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Martyrs’ blood, John’s manner, closing prayer (chs. 26–51) — Martyrdom CLOSEOUT
english: The martyrs’ blood still [[cries out from the ground >> Bible:Genesis 4:10]]. Hold John’s word on the manner of his death, and this closes with prayer for Ambrose and Protoctetus. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2 Exhortatio (OCR); no O’Meara/Greer wording.
